outline.text: Leverage falls only if the cash is kept: net debt drops from 5.9x to 3.8x EBITDA by FY27 in the base case, and cash flow covers interest about three times throughout.
The downside case holds leverage above 5x and still funds interest from operations. Debt is not repaid in either case, and about USD 17 billion falls due between 2028 and 2030.
The secured share of debt was not split out in the sources.
